task.title: Filtering rules by custom thresholds
task.shortdesc: Learn how to set specific thresholds for rules to filter your events in .

taskbody.context:
Setting a custom threshold for a rule can help you filter your video recordings to pinpoint particular driver behaviors. For example, you can set a threshold for the tailgating rule to events where drivers tailgated for more than 10 seconds.
All rules in the Critical, ADAS, and DMS categories in the Rules dropdown support custom thresholds.

step.cmd: Navigate to in the main menu.
Open the Rules dropdown menu and select the rule you want to view events for.
Click the More options menu to open the custom thresholds options.

info.note: If custom thresholds are not available for a rule, the More options icon will not appear when you select the rule from the list.

step.stepxmp: For example, if you select the tailgating rule, set the threshold condition dropdown to Duration. Then set the operator dropdown to Greater than or equal and the time field to 10 s. This will set a custom threshold that limits the rule to recorded tailgating events that lasted ten seconds or longer.

info.note: Different rules display different threshold options.

step.cmd: In the original dropdown list, click Apply again.

taskbody.result: The page automatically updates to show events matching your selected filters.
